h1: Ek zero wala patthar... aur baby kabhi mummy tak nahi pahunchega!
h2: Amazon, Google, Adobe... sabke interview mein ye sawaal: LeetCode fifty five, Jump Game!
p1: Baby bandar ko nadi paar karni hai, mummy us paar intezaar kar rahi hai. Har patthar pe ek number likha hai.
p2: Number ka matlab: yahan se zyada se zyada kitne patthar aage kood sakte ho... beech mein kahin bhi!
p3: Baby pehle patthar pe hai. Last patthar tak pahunchega? True ya false?
p4: Aage se socho, toh har patthar pe options hi options... har raasta try karoge, toh TLE!
p5: Trick: ulta chalo! Last patthar hai goal. Ab ek ek patthar peeche aao, aur bas ek sawaal poochho: index plus jump, goal tak pahunchta hai? Haan, toh goal yahin le aao!
p6: Goal chaar. Index teen: teen plus zero, teen... goal tak nahi, skip! Index do: do plus do, chaar! Goal do pe. Index ek: ek plus zero, ek... skip! Index zero: zero plus teen, teen... goal do tak pahunch gaya! Goal zero pe... TRUE!
p7: Code mein bas ek loop, peeche se: agar i plus nums of i, goal se bada ya barabar, toh goal barabar i. End mein goal zero? True! O of n time, O of one space!
p8: Ek line mein yaad rakho: ulta chalo, goal kheencho! Save karo, aur follow karo!
